title: Janax y Razar: un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador propios para un razonamiento artificial que piensa con melodías
description:
Janax is a hand-written operating system, language and assembler (all in assembly, no third-party engines) built to host Razar, an artificial reasoning system whose single judge is compression (two-part MDL). Version 1.73 (versions follow prime numbers; 173 after 167): her panel, green on black. Luma's words, what is typed to her and her last thought were drawn over her forms, and the letters mixed with the symbols. Now, under her forms and her creatures, a black band as wide as her window holds them, written by her in her own letters in the green of the film The Matrix (#00FF41, its trail #008F11): on the left her words, her last thought and what is typed; on the right her mind as it happens, her thoughts bright and every trial of her forms as her archive keeps it, about 29 a second, like rain. The band's height is measured, not chosen: the kernel shows her screen at the largest whole scale that fits 1280 x 800 (2), and the author's screen has 738 usable pixels with a 39-pixel frame, so 149 cells (16 lines). The panel is redrawn only when its print changes, and each line of her mind is measured once when it comes: measured cost 11.5% of one core against 7.4% before (the first version, measuring everything 29 times a second, took 26.6%). Stated limits: on a shorter screen the window is taller than the screen; the rain is her archive's lines as they are, not put into words; the print looks at the first and last letter of each thing. The kernel is unchanged since 1.39. Documentation is in Spanish.

Janax es un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador escritos a mano en assembler, hechos para alojar a Razar. v1.73: Luma escribe en un panel verde Matrix sobre negro, con su mente corriendo en tiempo real. Prototipo de investigación.
